Raid Player Position Planner

Drag name markers around the map. Click a name to select it.

Tip: drag markers with a mouse or finger. Double-click a marker to rename it. Your current layout is saved in this browser.

Players

Paste the macro output. New players are added; matching players keep their positions and receive the imported color.

Select a player and choose their class to apply its color. Your choice also applies to new players.

Choose a palette color to use a custom color instead.

Export layout copies all player names and map positions as JSON. You can reload it later using the exported file as a reference.
